abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HA Family Bell instance is allowed.
abort.already_configured: Only one HA Family Bell instance is allowed.
abort.invalid_saved_data: Saved Family Bell data is unreadable or unsupported. Its file has not been changed. Check your backup and Home Assistant logs.

error.no_tts_providers: Set up an available text-to-speech provider in Home Assistant first, then retry. It must provide a TTS entity.
error.provider_unavailable: The selected provider is no longer available. Choose an available provider.
error.no_supported_languages: This provider has no supported languages available. Check its setup or choose another provider.
error.unsupported_language: Choose a language from the provider's current supported list.
error.saved_data_missing: The saved data found earlier is no longer present. Choose a provider for new setup, or restore the data and restart setup.

user.title: Choose a speech provider
user.description: Select the text-to-speech provider for new announcements. No provider is selected automatically. The new schedule starts paused.

language.title: Choose a speech language
language.description: Select one of the language codes supported by your chosen provider. Setup does not play an announcement. You can change these settings later in the Family Bell panel.

existing.title: Use saved Family Bell data
existing.description: Saved Family Bell data was found. Existing schedules, speech settings and enabled states will be retained. Enabled schedules resume when setup finishes.

test.name: Test bell
test.description: Play a saved bell immediately without changing its schedule or message-set sequence.

id.name: Bell ID
id.description: Use bell_id from the Next bell sensor, including the routine:step form for a routine bell.
